supersedes.scope: Future seed derivation and stage allocation only. The v1 file is preserved byte-for-byte; no v1 seed identity is reused.
supersedes.reason: New root and seven-component selector for the v2 Prototype study; v1 identities remain reserved and collision-checked.

derivation.algorithm: deriveSeedHex SHA-256 over UTF-8 parts joined by one NUL byte
derivation.rule: Every materialized seed is the SHA-256 hex of all applicable parts joined by single NUL bytes. Every identity must be unique across LV01 v2 and collision-checked against all retained and registered earlier identities, including every v1 identity.
derivation.sharedPairing: Scenario and case identities and receiver action draws intentionally omit branch only, so paired branches share scenario, observation, pre-state and draw. Independent intervention shuffles and branch orders append branch. Learner initialization occurs once per dyad.
prohibited: reuse of development, qualification, pilot, main or repeat identities
reuse of any v1 or E00-E50 identity

development.iterationBoundary: The five-iteration lifetime allowance is not renewed; retained development-v2 through development-v23 directories keep their lifetime classifications.

qualification.purpose: Prototype profile qualification: private-state/input separation, scenario/control behavior, replay/pairing, evidence chronology, terminal/recovery accounting, statistics, full workload
qualification.qualificationBoundary: Twenty-five qualification seeds are separate from the twenty scientific pilot dyads and consume no research seeds.
qualification.scenarioControl: six no-learning/oracle conditions with 200 evaluation cases each on the v2 generator

pilot.reuseBoundary: No pilot/main reuse; no pilot/main seed reuse.
pilot.outcomeUse: Pilot output exposes centered dispersion, validity and costs only; pilot effect means cannot change design alternatives. An invalid or incomplete pilot cohort stops design lock; it does not silently grant another twenty runs or allow complete-case substitution.

confirmatory.selection: smallest candidate whose seven-component union-bound lower power is at least 0.90 and whose complete allocation fits the existing resource envelope; if that N cannot be funded, do not select a smaller underpowered N
confirmatory.replacement: ordered reserves replace validity failures only

replication.rule: fresh stage identities use the same selected N and ordered reserve rule as confirmatory; no outcome-based retuning; fresh-seed repeat executes regardless of main direction

power.screeningAlphaRule: 0.05/4 component screening alpha for the four-member family
power.monteCarloLowerBound: if k=0 then 0 else qbeta(0.05/42, k, 30000-k+1)
power.familyLowerBound: max(0, 1 - sum over seven components of (1 - component lower bound))
power.zeroDispersionRule: Zero or nonfinite dispersion blocks this selection procedure.
power.reserveInvalidity: one-sided 95% Wilson upper invalid-run probability; choose smallest R with P[Binomial(N+R,pUpper)<=R] >= 0.95 separately per main/repeat stage

resources.ceilingBoundary: Ceilings include prior work and are not unused allowances. They cover failures, retries, verifier and reproduction costs, temporary duplication and final retention.
resources.measurement: Reconcile historical charges first. Record every worker CPU, conservative peak memory, raw/exported bytes, verification, fitting, analysis, packaging, teardown and failures. Wall time is tracked separately from CPU. Missing historical CPU is charged by an existing defensible upper allocation; absent any bound leaves capacity unresolved.
resources.calibration: After five complete full-workload development dyads, reserve two times the largest complete per-slot CPU/storage/wall cost and 1.5 times the conservative peak-memory bound. Reconcile maxima again after pilot.
resources.designLock: Reserve the complete 2*(N+R) allocation plus overhead before main starts, plus a fixed analysis/reproduction/packaging allocation. Missing measurement blocks admission.
resources.deviationRule: If reconciliation shows the lifetime allowance exhausted, record the deviation and the exact additional bounded allowance required, and stop new experimental collection until a prospective authorization exists. This policy does not invent that authorization.
prohibited: treating historical remaining balances as current capacity
reducing N or reserves after pilot

claimBoundary: This policy does not allocate a stage, select N, authorize execution or create a finding.
